name: com.flowchartfromtext/flowchart
title: Flowchart From Text — Text-to-Mermaid Flowchart Generator
description: Convert structured text into Mermaid flowcharts and validate Mermaid diagram syntax.

tools.name: text_to_mermaid_flowchart
tools.description: Deterministically convert a plain-text step list, numbered list, indented outline, or arrow chain (A -> B -> C) with optional Yes/No decision branches into valid Mermaid flowchart syntax, returning node and edge metadata. Pure rule-based engine with no LLM calls.

text.description: Plain-text steps, numbered list, indented outline, or arrow chain (e.g. "Start -> Valid Input? -> Yes: Save -> Done").

direction.description: Optional Mermaid flowchart layout direction: TD (top-down), TB, LR (left-to-right), RL, or BT. Defaults to TD.

title.description: Optional short diagram title used for the suggested export filename and header metadata.

tools.name: validate_mermaid_diagram
tools.description: Deterministically lint and analyze Mermaid diagram syntax (flowchart, sequence, ER, Gantt, mindmap, state). Detects diagram category, counts nodes and edges, and reports line-level structural syntax issues.

source.description: Mermaid diagram source code to validate and analyze (e.g. "flowchart TD\n  A[Start] --> B[End]").
